import pathlib,json,os,sys,time,subprocess,tarfile,gzip,base64,statistics,hashlib
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
old=root/'previous';old.mkdir()
with tarfile.open(root/'previous.tar.gz')as t:t.extractall(old,filter='data')
import torch,triton
report={'kind':'evaluator-efficiency-before-after','device':torch.cuda.get_device_name(0),'torch':torch.__version__,'triton':triton.__version__,'cuda':torch.version.cuda,'scenarios':[],'baseline_commit':'ff7e49702c0ea3e0865b49079ccf43141b490e7d','task_scope':'Identical torch.add baseline/candidate. Three matched repeats, reverse old/new order on alternate blocks, rotated mode order. Cold bootstrap excluded. No agent search comparison.'}
assert torch.cuda.device_count()==1
print('KE_ENV '+json.dumps(report),flush=True)
# Same correctness suite, including all GPU gates, runs against the optimized evaluator.
tests=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pytest','-q','--junitxml='+str(root/'pytest.xml')],cwd=root,env=os.environ|{'KERNEL_ENVOLVE_TEST_CUDA':'1'},stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=600)
(root/'pytest.log').write_text(tests.stdout);print(tests.stdout,flush=True)
report['tests_returncode']=tests.returncode;report['test_summary']=tests.stdout.splitlines()[-1]
assert tests.returncode==0,tests.stdout

def one(revision,size,mode):
 src=(old if revision=='previous' else root)/'src'
 started=time.perf_counter()
 out=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(root/'measure_revision.py'),str(size),mode],cwd=root,env=os.environ|{'PYTHONPATH':str(src)},stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,timeout=240)
 elapsed=time.perf_counter()-started
 assert out.returncode==0,(revision,size,mode,out.stdout[-3000:],out.stderr[-3000:])
 row=json.loads(out.stdout);row['revision']=revision;row['command_wall_seconds']=elapsed
 return row
# Bootstrap both versions once, so cold CUDA initialization/file cache does not favor one arm.
report['bootstrap']=[one(revision,257,'check')for revision in ['previous','current']]
for repeat in range(3):
 sizes=[257,1048577,4194305]if repeat%2==0 else [4194305,1048577,257]
 modes=['check','signal','quick','full'];modes=modes[repeat:]+modes[:repeat]
 for size in sizes:
  for i,mode in enumerate(modes):
   revisions=['previous','current']if (repeat+i)%2==0 else ['current','previous']
   for revision in revisions:
    row=one(revision,size,mode);row['repeat']=repeat;report['scenarios'].append(row)
    print('KE_COST '+json.dumps({k:v for k,v in row.items()if k!='result'}|{'phases':row['result'].get('phase_wall_seconds'),'checks':len(row['result']['checks']),'samples':len(row['result']['samples'])}),flush=True)
report['completed']=True
(root/'efficiency.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
blob=base64.b64encode(gzip.compress(json.dumps(report).encode())).decode()
# Bounded log chunks preserve a report even when it exceeds one CloudWatch event.
for offset in range(0,len(blob),32000):print('KE_REPORT_PART '+json.dumps({'index':offset//32000,'total':(len(blob)+31999)//32000,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(blob.encode()).hexdigest(),'data':blob[offset:offset+32000]}),flush=True)
print('KE_VALIDATION_DONE',flush=True)

measure_revision.py.source:
import sys,json,pathlib,time,tempfile
from kernel_envolve.cli import evaluate
from kernel_envolve.storage import evaluator_hash
size,mode=int(sys.argv[1]),sys.argv[2]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ke-efficiency-') as tmp:
 task=pathlib.Path(tmp).resolve()
 (task/'task.json').write_text(json.dumps({'name':'efficiency-cost-probe','objective':'Evaluator wall time on identical torch.add implementations; no kernel speedup claim','device':'cuda:0','cases':[{'id':'fixed','args':{'n':size},'weight':1}]}))
 (task/'task.py').write_text('import torch\ndef make_inputs(case,seed):\n g=torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)\n return tuple(torch.randn(case["n"],device="cuda",generator=g) for _ in range(2))\ndef reference(x,y): return x+y\nbaseline=reference\n')
 (task/'candidate.py').write_text('def run(x,y): return x+y\n')
 kw={'check_only':True}if mode=='check' else {'signal_only':True}if mode=='signal'else {'mode':mode}
 started=time.perf_counter();run,result=evaluate(task,timeout=180,**kw);elapsed=time.perf_counter()-started
 assert result['execution']=='completed' and result['correctness']=='pass',result
 counts={'check':(4,0),'signal':(4,6),'quick':(8,12),'full':(16,80)}
 assert (len(result['checks']),len(result['samples']))==counts[mode]
 print(json.dumps({'size':size,'mode':mode,'evaluator_hash':evaluator_hash(),'evaluate_wall_seconds':elapsed,'result':result}),flush=True)

Use a fresh checkout for each repetition of the entire probe.
